summary: Post CSS-fix smoke verification of GOD OF WAR guild app. Verified index.css line 361-388 override block is syntactically clean (no /* */ nesting). App loads with no 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Backend /api/auth/login, /api/members (list + name-only POST) all return 200. Frontend Stone & Fire theme, guest access to /komutanlar with rarity frames + language badges, admin login, /uyeler accordion with GOW header + R5/R4/R3/R2 rank badges, and TR->EN i18n switcher on Commanders sidebar all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css comment block (line 361-363) is now safe — no */ substrings inside /* */ comment bodies. Consider adding a Stylelint rule (comment-no-empty / no-invalid) to catch this class of regression automatically.
Login page: password input has type=password but username input has type=None (no explicit type). Minor a11y/autofill improvement — set type='text' and name/autocomplete attributes.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_smoke_member_* row created via POST /api/members during smoke test; safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSS regression from stray */ inside comment at index.css:363 is fixed. All previously reported flows (Stone&Fire theme, rarity frames orange/purple/blue, name-only member POST, i18n TR<->EN sidebar on Commanders, guest access to / and /komutanlar, 6-item bottom nav after login, R5/R4/R3/R2 badges on Üyeler) verified functional. No open issues.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /* Forces existing bg-red-*/yellow-*/text-white */ — the '*/' inside the comment body prematurely terminated the CSS block-comment, leaving stray '/yellow-*/text-white */' as invalid CSS tokens which PostCSS reported as 'Unexpected /'. Fix: main agent rewrote the comment without any */ sequences (now: 'Forces bg-red / yellow / text-white utilities and gray shades'). Mitigation: CSS block comments cannot be nested; never place */ inside a /* */ body. Add Stylelint or a simple grep pre-commit check for '/\*[^*]*\*/[^*/]*\*/' patterns.
